assessmentQuestionVersion.name: PSE_RiskAssessment_Q3
assessmentQuestionVersion.questionText: Infection control plan (select based on the highest risk or most complex service offered at the facility)
assessmentQuestionVersion.responseValues: Non-compliant: No infection control plan exists, or significant deficiencies are present such that the facility cannot demonstrate compliance or operate safely. Partially compliant: Infection control plan exists, but deficiencies are identified with its content, implementation, review, employee training, or adherence to procedures. Compliant: Infection control plan is current, contains the required information, employees have been trained, and the facility demonstrates implementation of the plan.
